skill.name: shadcn
skill.description: Guides shadcn project setup, component discovery, installation, updates, styling, composition, registries, presets, and accessible interface implementation.
skill.summary: Build and maintain shadcn interfaces with project-aware CLI workflows and component guidance.
skill.author: shadcn-ui

security_audit.summary: Review confirmed one high-severity risk: the skill automatically executes an unpinned `shadcn@latest` package during context injection. The other 131 findings are documentation syntax, example URLs, accessibility text, or relative links without dangerous behavior.

remediation.issue: Automatic execution of a moving npm package version during skill loading.
remediation.suggestion: Pin an audited shadcn version and require user confirmation before running the context command.

content.value_statement: Shadcn projects require precise component, registry, preset, and styling decisions. This skill provides project-aware workflows for building and updating consistent interfaces.
actual_capabilities: Reads shadcn project context through the CLI.
Searches registries and retrieves component documentation.
Guides component installation, updates, diffs, and overwrite decisions.
Applies project-specific styling, composition, form, icon, and accessibility rules.
Supports preset changes, registry authoring, and MCP setup guidance.
limitations: Requires a compatible project and an available shadcn CLI.
Registry content remains third-party code that requires review before installation.
Preset application can modify components, fonts, configuration, and CSS variables.
The guidance does not replace project tests, linting, or visual verification.

use_cases.title: Build a React interface
use_cases.description: Select and compose shadcn components that match the current project configuration.

use_cases.title: Maintain a component library
use_cases.description: Preview upstream changes and preserve local modifications during component updates.

use_cases.title: Publish a registry
use_cases.description: Structure, build, and verify reusable registry items for downstream projects.

prompt_templates.title: Add a component
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this shadcn project, add a dialog component, and show which files changed.

prompt_templates.title: Build an accessible form
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an accessible account form using installed shadcn components and the project styling conventions.

prompt_templates.title: Update without losing changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the installed button with upstream, preserve local changes, and apply only compatible updates.

prompt_templates.title: Design a project registry
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this registry structure, correct invalid includes and dependencies, then define a verification workflow.

output_examples.input: Add a settings dialog to this project.
output: Project context identifies the framework, aliases, base library, and package manager.
The dialog is previewed before installation.
The final composition includes accessible title and description elements.

output_examples.input: Update the locally modified button component.
output: The update report separates upstream changes from local modifications.
Compatible changes are merged without an unconditional overwrite.
Remaining conflicts are listed for user review.

output_examples.input: Switch only the project theme preset.
output_examples.output: The preset is inspected first, then only the theme is applied while components and fonts remain unchanged.

best_practices: Inspect project context before selecting components or package commands.
Use dry runs and diffs before updating existing source files.
Review every third-party registry item before installation.
anti_patterns: Do not overwrite locally modified components without explicit approval.
Do not guess a registry when the user has not selected one.
Do not hardcode aliases, icon libraries, raw colors, or framework assumptions.

faq.question: Does this skill install shadcn components?
faq.answer: It guides and runs supported shadcn CLI workflows when tool permissions and project context allow.

faq.question: Can it update modified components?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses dry runs and file diffs to preserve local changes.

faq.question: Does it support community registries?
faq.answer: Yes. Registry selection must be explicit, and added files should be reviewed.

faq.question: Can it switch presets?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports overwrite, partial, merge, and configuration-only approaches after user selection.

faq.question: Does it support Base UI and Radix?
faq.answer: Yes. It reads project context and adapts component patterns to the configured base.

faq.question: Will it validate the finished interface?
faq.answer: It applies documented rules, but project tests, linting, and visual checks remain necessary.
